name: hurt-left
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation sheet of the EXACT accepted zombie decayed human villager shown in the reference, which is an IDENTITY/STYLE reference only, NOT layout to copy. Same gaunt adult human, cloudy dead white eyes, sparse messy dark hair, gray-green decayed skin, ragged dirty beige sleeveless linen tunic, dull brown belt and torn brown trousers and worn brown shoes; unarmed empty five-fingered human hands. Detailed shaded textured retro dungeon illustration, crisp edges and muted materials, same lighting/proportions/clothing tears and anatomy. Human ears, no weapons/armor, never cute. Genuine TRANSPARENT alpha background and alpha holes, no background, floor, painted shadow, glow, grid, labels or text. Generous transparent outer margins and between poses; no silhouette may touch its neighbor or sheet edge. Same anatomical scale in all frames. STRICT LEFT PROFILE facing screen-LEFT, one eye visible, nose and shoes point LEFT. Exactly TWO COMPLETE full-body HURT reactions left then right in two equal cells on a horizontal landscape 1536x1024 sheet. Frame 1 violent torso recoil BACK toward screen-right, head/jaw jerks backward, shoulders arch and arms flail, knees flex while shoes stay on ground. Frame 2 returns toward hunched standing facing LEFT, arms settle. Keep original head/body scale and planted shoe baseline. Distinct hurt and recovery poses, no death/fall, no painted flash or blood effect. Generous clear margins, unclipped whole bodies around 760px high.
